roles.title: Senior Analytical Lead, then Analytical Director

requirements.text: Hire and coach a team of senior individual contributors, giving them the context and room to lead their own work.
Make sure each metric has a clear owner and is well maintained. Team members own individual metrics; you support them and get involved when a decision needs it.
Develop a view on how our measurement should change over time, and shape it with business leaders in Content, Finance, and Product.
Help partners work out what to measure when new questions come up, and how much rigor the answer needs.
Set and maintain the practices the broader organization uses to build and validate measurements.
Work with data engineering and product teams so that established metrics are reliable and well documented for the people who use them.
3+ years managing technical teams, ideally with a mix of technical skill sets, with a track record of hiring well and helping people grow
A strong coach who gives candid feedback with care, helps people see where they can grow, and develops senior individual contributors into leaders
An advanced degree in statistics, economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience
A background as a hands-on data scientist, with depth in areas such as statistical modeling, causal inference, or experimentation
Experience designing and validating metrics, including proxy metrics, checking a metric against the outcome it stands in for, and understanding its variance
Experience running metrics in production across organizations, including definitions, governance, and change management
Experience explaining analysis and its limits to senior, non-technical audiences
Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other re…

Content & Games Data Science and Engineering (DSE) is the data science and engineering organization for Netflix's content and games businesses. We work closely with leaders in C…
We're looking for a manager to lead MSA, a team of senior data practitioners with a mix of technical skill sets. We want someone who can go deep on methodology with the team and…
Hold a high bar for the quality of the team's science and analysis, and give direct, useful feedback on methodology.
Comfort working on problems that haven't been defined yet
A deep curiosity about the mix of art and science that goes into making great content; experience in entertainment is a plus but not required
Enthusiasm for and compatibility with Netflix culture
Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.
Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.
